name: synthetic
description:
Synthetic EPUB in the shape a real publisher ships (Taylor & Francis / Routledge): the whole article wrapped in
, and every in-text citation already wired as . Both halves were blind spots — the existing epub fixtures are flat bodies with unlinked prose, so a book collapsing to 2 nodes and 0 converted anchors passed the whole suite. Guards: node_count proves the wrappers were flattened (a real T&F EPUB produced 2 nodes of ~60k chars), citation_links proves the publisher's own anchors were re-pointed at our entry ids, and node 8 proves a loose inline run outside any

becomes ONE paragraph rather than a node per fragment.

citation_links.node_contains: Loose prose the publisher left outside
